_open_questions_surfaced.question: Convention 2 (observed_on) had no case for a nominee report (the form's Date of Appointment is blank). RULED 2026-06-01 (methodology, Convention 2 extension): a nominee report's observed_on = the filer-signature date, the only point at which the document certifies the holdings were accurate. observed_on on all cp_filing_0005 edges = 2025-01-25 is ruled, not provisional. Confirmation (2025-05-19) and swearing-in (2025-07-11) are milestones in the filer's timeline, not as-of statements, and the post-divestiture window would make the snapshot false by then. A later incumbent annual will carry its own prior-year-end observed_on; different as-of dates for overlapping entities is correct, not a supersession.

Live 18 USC 208(a)(2) spousal-imputation cases: Westminster Management, LLC (spouse retains equity, Part 5, $5M-$25M) and Westminster Pillar Management, LLC (Part 6 item 107, $5M-$25M, Management Fees $100,001-$250,000; spouse equity + fees per Ethics Agreement Section 4). Westminster Pillar is in the filing (Part 6, not Part 1). Spousal/imputed-edge modeling is deferred to Fork S, not folded into the bulk ingest.

Ethics Agreement Appendix B (~150 publicly-traded securities + foreign equities) plus the SPDR S&P Biotech ETF and Millennium USA LP (Section 3), and the Part 6 public-equity block (pp 18-43), are DIVESTED within 90 days of confirmation per the Ethics Agreement (2025-04-14) and Certification (2025-08-22). Logged here, not flooded into the registry as soft-flagged entities.

Certification Section 3b indicates no 278-T was filed for the divestitures, yet a 278-T dated 09/26/2025 was requested/expected. Hold the tension; the 278-T gets its own ingest when it arrives and the discrepancy is a determination then.
